capabilities: Replace default file and folder icons globally, including separate collapsed and expanded folder icons
Assign icons by file extension or folder name with drag-ordered priority rules
Set per-path icons via the file explorer context menu
Create custom icons by pasting SVG, importing SVG files, or drawing on a built-in canvas
Pick icons from a searchable picker with recently used icons
extras: Notes that visual results can be affected by the theme or other file-tree plugins, and that icons may need a manual refresh via a command.
problem: Obsidian's file explorer uses uniform default icons, making it hard to distinguish note types, folders, and important files at a glance.
summary: File explorer icon customizer that replaces file and folder icons via global defaults, extension/name rules, per-path overrides, and custom SVGs.
